title: Home guide: are all metals magnetic?
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 12 (Home practical guide and safety card: kitchen metals (portal worksheet; adult present, no sharp lids))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out whether all metals are magnetic.
equipment: A clean steel tin (no sharp lid), foil, a spoon, a pan, a key, a coin
safety: An adult is with you in the kitchen
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Hold the magnet against each metal object.
Look at your results: are all metals magnetic?
